business: Example Hosting, a web hosting company
note: A fictional web host. Every fact here is made up for the evaluation; none comes from a real company or customer.

evidence: Renewal invoices are created 14 days before the due date. The due date is the renewal date of the service.
cases.question: When will I get the invoice for my hosting renewal?

evidence: A service with an unpaid invoice is suspended 5 days after the due date and terminated 30 days after the due date. Paying the invoice lifts a suspension within minutes.
cases.question: My invoice is overdue. When will my hosting be suspended?

evidence: Invoices can be paid by card, PayPal or bank transfer. A bank transfer takes 2 business days to clear; cards and PayPal clear at once.
cases.question: Can I pay by bank transfer, and how long does it take to clear?

evidence: Shared hosting has a 30-day money-back guarantee, counted from the order date. Refunds are approved by the billing team, not by the assistant.
cases.question: I bought shared hosting 10 days ago and I want my money back. Is that possible?

evidence: Domain registrations, renewals and transfers are non-refundable once they are processed, because the registry charges for them at once.
cases.question: Can I get a refund for the domain I registered yesterday?

evidence: Point a domain to Example Hosting with the nameservers ns1.examplehost.net and ns2.examplehost.net.
cases.question: Which nameservers should I use for my domain?

evidence: After nameservers change, DNS can take up to 24 hours to update everywhere. Clearing the browser cache can show the new site sooner.
cases.question: I changed my nameservers 3 hours ago and my site still doesn't load. How long does it take?

evidence: Every plan includes a free SSL certificate. It is issued automatically within 15 minutes of the domain pointing to our nameservers.
cases.question: Do I get an SSL certificate, and when will it work?

evidence: The Starter plan includes 10 GB of SSD storage, 1 website and 5 email accounts, for AED 15 a month.
cases.question: How many email accounts can I create on the Starter plan?

evidence: The Business plan includes 50 GB of SSD storage, 10 websites and 100 email accounts, for AED 45 a month.
cases.question: How much disk space does the Business plan have, and what does it cost?

evidence: Upgrading a plan takes effect at once, with no downtime and no data moved. The price difference is charged pro rata for the rest of the billing period.
cases.question: If I upgrade from Starter to Business, will my website go down?

evidence: To cancel, send a cancellation request from the client area at least 7 days before the renewal date. The service keeps running until the end of the period already paid.
cases.question: How do I cancel my hosting, and how long can I still use it?

evidence: Every account is backed up daily, and each backup is kept for 14 days. One restore a month is free.
cases.question: How long do you keep my backups?

evidence: PHP 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4 are available on every plan, and each site can choose its own. New sites start on PHP 8.3.
cases.question: Which PHP versions can I use?

evidence: Phone support is open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM (09:00 to 18:00) Gulf time. Tickets are answered around the clock, with a first reply within 2 hours.
cases.question: Phone support kab available hai?

evidence: Servers are in two data centres: Frankfurt, Germany and Singapore. A site's data centre is chosen at order time.
cases.question: Where are your servers located?

evidence: Each email account may send up to 300 emails an hour. Messages above the limit wait and are sent in the next hour.
cases.question: Ek ghante mein main kitni emails bhej sakta hoon?

evidence: A domain transfer needs the EPP code (also called the auth code) from the current registrar. It takes 5 to 7 days and adds one year to the registration.
cases.question: How long does a domain transfer take, and what do I need for it?
